title: Hardcoded Administrative Secret Token Exposed in Client-Side Bundle
description: The administrative Bearer token was previously present in client-side Vue source files.
claimed_root_cause: Static frontend files contained hardcoded administrative credentials for API authorization.

trace.description: Fetch request dispatches to /api/ with credentials: same-origin without static Bearer tokens
Authentication delegates to Nginx Basic Auth gateway and dynamic session headers

evidence.description: Verified: Hardcoded Bearer token completely removed. Built JS contains 0 references to SecDash-Admin-Secret-Key-2026.

reason: Verified remediated. Hardcoded Bearer token was completely stripped from all client stores and Vue components; ingress protection is now enforced via Nginx Basic Auth.

title: Missing Authentication Check on POST /api/logs Audit Log Ingestion
description: The POST /api/logs endpoint previously accepted requests without verifying caller authorization.
claimed_root_cause: Omission of verify_token(authorization) in the save_log handler.

trace.description: Endpoint enforces verify_token() and returns HTTP 401 for unauthenticated calls

evidence.description: Tested curl POST /api/logs without authentication; server returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

reason: Verified remediated. Endpoint now enforces verify_token(authorization=authorization, x_remote_user=x_remote_user, x_admin_token=x_admin_token) and Nginx Basic Auth, blocking all unauthenticated log writes.

title: Ingress Authentication Inconsistency Between UI and API Endpoints
description: The backend API reverse proxy at /api/ previously lacked Nginx Basic Auth directives.
claimed_root_cause: Asymmetric gateway protection in Nginx reverse proxy configuration.

trace.description: Ingress request to /api/ intercepted by Nginx auth_basic
Returns HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm=Security Dashboard

evidence.description: Tested curl -I https://nenenainaemak.duckdns.org/api/state; server returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

reason: Verified remediated. Both /secdash/ and /api/ now share identical Nginx Basic Authentication policies and pass verified X-Remote-User headers to backend.

title: Wildcard CORS Configuration Combined with Allow Credentials
description: FastAPI CORSMiddleware was previously configured with allow_origins=['*'].
claimed_root_cause: Permissive development CORS middleware settings left in production API.

trace.description: Client sends cross-origin request with Origin header
Rejects arbitrary origins and only permits explicitly whitelisted domains

evidence.description: Tested curl with Origin: https://evil-attacker.com; Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is omitted/blocked.

reason: Verified remediated. allow_origins is locked to explicit trusted origins ['https://nenenainaemak.duckdns.org', 'http://localhost:5173', 'http://localhost'], eliminating wildcard credential reflection.

title: Unauthenticated Exposure of System Firewall State and Logs
description: GET /api/state and GET /api/logs previously returned operational data without authentication.
claimed_root_cause: Missing verify_token and gateway protection on read endpoints.

trace.description: Enforces authorization verification before reading state.json or admin_logs.json

evidence.description: Tested curl -I https://nenenainaemak.duckdns.org/api/logs without auth; returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

reason: Verified remediated. Read endpoints now require active Basic Auth credentials or valid operator tokens.

title: Arbitrary Origin Reflection with Credentials on REST API
description: The WordPress REST API previously reflected untrusted Origin headers with credentials enabled.
claimed_root_cause: Nginx / WordPress CORS filter dynamically echoed incoming Origin headers with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

trace.description: Response returns locked Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://nenenainaemak.duckdns.org and Allow-Credentials: false

evidence.description: Tested GET /wp-json/ with Origin: https://evil-attacker.com returned locked origin and Allow-Credentials: false

reason: Verified remediated. The server now returns an allowlisted Origin (https://nenenainaemak.duckdns.org) and disables credentials (false), blocking cross-origin credentialed requests.

title: WordPress REST API User Enumeration via /wp/v2/users
description: Unauthenticated callers could previously enumerate all system usernames and IDs via the REST API.
claimed_root_cause: Default WordPress REST API exposed the users collection to unauthenticated clients.
reason: Verified remediated. MU-Plugin unsets the endpoint for unauthenticated callers, completely preventing enumeration.
